headline: Dollar Surprises by Reaching One-Year High and Closes Near $965 After Expectations of Another Fed Rate Hike
summary: The dollar reached a one-year high against the Chilean peso, closing near 965 after expectations of another Fed rate hike. Copper prices also corrected.
why: The Chilean peso moves with copper prices, Chile's main export, and with US interest rate expectations.
